description: Log one business trip as a calculated-value expense row. Requires a configured mileage rate (cents/km or cents/mi) and unit (mi/km). For route calculation, mileage settings, repeated trips, calendar/rideshare imports, per diem or visual review use Mileage and travel from get_spreadsheet_url.

category.description: Override the user's default mileage category (optional)

date.description: Trip date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required. Use the date the user gives; for "today" send today's calendar date in their timezone. If no date was given, ask.

distance.description: Distance traveled in the user's configured unit (miles or km)

notes.description: Optional user-supplied context stored with the mileage entry.

purpose.description: Business purpose / description of the trip (e.g., 'Client meeting at 1234 Main St')

roundTrip.description: If true, doubles the distance (return trip)

name: add_mileage_entry
